correctness.rationale: The ambient harmonic dimension is m-1 in the sense that the polynomials live on the (m-1)-dimensional zero-sum subspace. Independently derived the unit-diagonal zonal polynomial by imposing the Laplace equation on z^5+aRz^3+bR^2z, where z is the coordinate along a unit vector and R is squared norm. The addition formula makes the true evaluation Gramian dim(H_5) times this matrix. For each Johnson sector i, the product of i membership contrasts on disjoint pairs belongs to the i-incidence space and is orthogonal to lower incidence spaces by a pair swap. Summing its kernel action at a triple with one selected member of each pair independently gives the four factored scalars. All modular residue lists match; only the constant sector can vanish for integer m>=7 and only at 27. The independent values at 27 are 0, 855/256, 455/256, 225/256 in sectors of dimensions 1, 26, 324, 2574. The m=6 boundary gives rank ten. At 27 any deleted centroid leaves independent rows because the unique relation has every coefficient nonzero. The tangent Laplacian applied to p5 and R*p3 verifies H_27 is harmonic, and exact substitution gives zero at each unnormalized triangle centroid and 7475/13122 at every unnormalized vertex; normalization preserves both properties. The replacement row is independent, and the stated pseudoinverse interpolation and norm have the correct normalization.
residual_risks: The calculation concerns exact degree five on the full triple orbit or the stated single-vertex replacement, not all degree-at-most-five polynomials or other replacement points.
